description:
FOUND s436 (Opus 5) while landing #469 (the phase model), by perl-tests/
caller.t losing exactly two rows.

THE OBSERVATION: a `p-BEGIN` form's emission begins with
`(p-set-current-package :Pkg "Pkg")` and there is no matching restore.  Before
s436 that was invisible: a section's BEGINs ran immediately before that same
section's run-time forms, which is a package the section then set for itself.
Under the phase model every section's BEGINs run in the compile phase, so the
package left current when the run phase starts is THE LAST BEGIN'S, wherever
in the file it sat.

MEASURED: perl-tests/caller.t 15/49 -> 13/49.  Line 369 is
`{ package RT129239; BEGIN { â¦ } }`; line 129 is `is( eval 'pb()', 'main::pb',
"actually return the right function name" )`.  With RT129239 left current, the
string eval transpiled in RT129239, `pb` did not resolve there, and the row
answered undef.  Two rows, both of that shape.

WORKED AROUND, not fixed: the phase model now emits
`(p-set-current-package â¦)` at the head of EVERY run group, section 0
included, whenever the file has more than one section â "no run group may
assume a package it did not state".  caller.t is back to 15/49 and a
one-section file's emission is byte-identical.

WHY IT IS STILL WORTH A TASK: the workaround covers the run groups, which is
where the damage was measurable, but the underlying asymmetry stands and can
bite anywhere a BEGIN is followed by code that reads the current package
without setting it first -- an INIT/CHECK closure, a `p-run-compile-phase-blocks`
callee, a runtime `require` that loads a module whose BEGIN switches package.
perl's own model is that a `package` statement inside a BEGIN block is scoped
to that block.

FIX SHAPE (not designed): make p-BEGIN bind *pcl-current-package* rather than
setf it -- i.e. the same dynamic-extent discipline the sub-call path already
uses -- and check the same question for p-END and the compile-phase block
closures.  It is a `cl/` change, so the full sweep is the gate (WHAT-TO-RUN
table), and a cheap first measurement is: does any emitted BEGIN body rely on
the package it sets OUTLIVING the block?  Grep the corpus for a
`p-set-current-package` inside a p-BEGIN whose section package differs.
subject: p-BEGIN sets the runtime current package on ENTRY and never restores it â harmless until the s436 phase model made every BEGIN run before every run-time statement
